info.name: Paneliya Enterprise HRMS API
info.description:
Professional Postman collection for Paneliya Multi-Company HRMS Backend API.

### Roles Hierarchy:
- **SUPER_ADMIN**: Platform software owner, manages companies, assigns admins, cross-company reporting
- **ADMIN**: Company administrator, strictly isolated to own company, creates/manages company employees
- **EMPLOYEE**: Company employee, read-only permissions for organizational data

### Getting Started:
1. Run request **"1. Super Admin Login"** in the **"⭐ 0. Multi-Company Walkthrough"** folder.
2. The login test script will automatically save the `token` variable.
3. All subsequent requests in this collection automatically inherit the `{{token}}` bearer token.
